intro: Ruga Ragetotem is a veteran tauren warrior stationed at Camp Taurajo in the southern Barrens. Serving as a mentor to promising Horde fighters, he tests their mettle against the strange silithid infestation emerging nearby before sending them toward custom armor.

p: Standing watch over Camp Taurajo, Ruga Ragetotem helps train emerging warriors looking to prove their strength in Kalimdor. Recognizing the sudden, unsettling emergence of insectoid silithid carving hives into the Field of Giants to the south, Ruga sets a trial for young fighters to hunt the beasts and sever their antennae. Those who endure the ordeal earn his respect and a recommendation to the renowned armorsmith Thun'grim Firegaze.

related.n: Trial at the Field of Giants
